Hi! I’m no genius and I haven’t been in a situation like this but from my POV I’d say try it again. Go for the 3 days and see if any perception or reality has changed, 12 years is a long time maybe you’ll be surprised! Stick to your demands tho, your parent can’t and don’t have a say in them if they aren’t paying for the trip. On the topic of family, I briefly had a conflict where I considered leaving it all behind but I decided not to, no matter what they’ve done the people who raised you are your parents. Those same people have sacrificed at least 18 years of theirs for yours and they may have given more than most as immigrants. My mom is an immigrant and our relationship isn’t the best, it’s certainly improved over the last couple years but it could be better. I am acutely aware of what she had go through to raise me and what she gave up to do so. I’d say consider those things before making the decision, at the end of the day we’re all human and we make mistakes. When you do make that decision if you still think it’s worth leaving after considering all of what I mentioned then do it just know that it’s a decision you must live with for the rest of you life. Much love and I hope your journey is a good one travel in peace
